description: In Year 103161, The Great Unified Imperium successfully annexed colonies of The Consolidated Scientific Systems after a siege on their outer defense platforms.
In Year 100937, a joint colony was founded in Capella Nebula by settlers from both The Great Vesperan Imperium and The Great Scientific Imperium.
The The Consolidated-Consolidated Scientific Alliance was established as a Research Alliance including members: f8c1278b86,4836a15586.
In Year 100187, a rogue AI network in The Scientific AI Hegemony initiated a localized machine uprising, causing widespread panic in Aldebaran Beta.
The The Consolidated-Unified Scientific Alliance was established as a Research Alliance including members: 95cba99a70,7419a59432.
